text: dsh-read-image-view（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：让 DSH 对话中的 read_image 结果以完整图片预览呈现。它为 read_image 工具结果注册专用显示行，通过宿主附件加载器显示图片。主要功能包括完整比例缩略预览、同一请求多图画廊、键盘和触控缩放、拖动平移以及失败重试。适合在 Web 对话里查看长截图、宽图和透明图片的用户。使用前需要安装到 DSH Web 并重启；不需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-read-image-view displays read_image previews in DSH Web. It adds a result row and uses the host attachment loader. Browse multiple images; zoom and pan with keyboard or touch. Useful for screenshots, panoramas and transparent images. Install and restart; no extra key is needed.
想在 DSH 对话里直接看模型读取的图片
DSH 的图片结果被截断了，怎么查看完整长图？
让 Web 对话里的多张图片可以逐张切换
我想放大 read_image 返回的图片并拖动查看细节
How can I view the full image returned in a DSH conversation?
I need to zoom and pan around images read by the model.
Show every image from one image-reading request in a gallery.
dsh-read-image-view 功能「完整图片预览」：图片阅读结果以完整比例缩略图显示，点击图片可打开原图画廊；长图和宽图不会被卡片裁切。
dsh-read-image-view 功能「多图画廊」：同一用户请求内的 read_image 结果可合并浏览，并在画廊中逐张切换；图片由宿主附件接口按需加载。
dsh-read-image-view 功能「缩放与平移」：画廊支持滚轮、按钮和触控缩放，也可拖动查看放大后的区域；提供适应视口和 100% 查看。
Feature “Full previews”: Show complete previews of tall and wide images. Select one to open the gallery.
Feature “Image gallery”: Browse images from one request together and select an attachment to inspect it.
透明图片预览时能不能显示棋盘格背景？

dsh-read-image-view README · 中文：**把 DSH 的 `read_image` 结果变成完整图片预览和可缩放画廊。** 长截图、宽图和透明图都能在对话里直接看；一次返回多张图片也不会遗漏。

纯客户端插件，零生产依赖，使用宿主提供的会话授权图片加载器。

dsh-read-image-view README · 安装与使用：在 DSH 插件市场搜索 **dsh-read-image-view**，安装后重启 Harness。命令行 Web 用户也可以运行：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add npm:dsh-read-image-view@0.4.0
```

随后重启 `dsh web`。让模型读取图片，点预览即可打开画廊。

dsh-read-image-view README · 安装与使用：**DSH Desktop：** 已在 Windows 11 虚拟机中验证 [DSH Desktop 0.11.1](https://github.com/dataelement/dsh-desktop/releases/tag/v0.11.1)，其内置 Harness 为 **0.2.0-rc.2**，使用桌面应用自己数据目录中的 **web profile**。优先在桌面应用内安装，再用 **Harness → 重启**。外部 CLI 的默认 DSH_HOME 可能指向另一套配置；使用 CLI 时须先指定桌面应用的实际 DSH_HOME。桌面版已管理过的插件可能使用独立版本目录，外部 CLI 安装会在重启时被旧登记覆盖，因此升级请使用应用内插件管理。

如果宿主折叠了“已完成”或“已读取图片”的工具过程，先展开该过程。插件自己的图片行默认展开。

dsh-read-image-view README · 0.4.0 有什么改进：| 功能 | 用法 |
| --- | --- |
| 完整预览 | 长图和宽图按完整比例放进卡片，不截掉底部或右侧 |
| 多图画廊 | 同次请求合并展示；一次工具结果里的所有图片均可切换 |
| 缩放与平移 | 滚轮、＋/−、拖动、双指缩放；适应窗口或 100% |
| 键盘 | ←/→ 切图，＋/− 缩放，`0` 为 100%，`f` 适应，Esc 关闭 |
| 焦点 | Tab/Shift+Tab 留在画廊内，关闭后返回打开图片的按钮 |
| 按需加载 | 接近视口才请求图片；失败可重试，关闭后异步结果不会重新弹出 |
| 透明图 | 卡片和放大层均有棋盘格，便于辨认透明区域 |

**100% 的含义：** 一个宿主返回位图像素对应一个 CSS 像素。宿主可能先缩小或转换源图；插件会显示返回尺寸，并在元数据可用时标明源图尺寸。放大超过 100% 会插值，不会恢复已丢失的细节。高 DPI 屏幕的物理像素与 CSS 像素也不同。

dsh-read-image-view README · 实际桌面验证：以下为虚拟机中真实 DSH Desktop 渲染器截图，使用宿主真实附件存储和持久化会话。验证数据为人工构造的工具结果，未调用模型。

测试环境为 Windows 11 22621.4112、150% DPI。覆盖三张图片、失败结果、切图、100%、键盘焦点、Esc 和重复打开。另有 Chromium 自动回归覆盖 12000px 长图、手机横竖屏、双指缩放、加载中关闭、重试和按需加载。

宿主实际拒绝 12000px 源图；桌面验证使用 600×8000 源图，宿主返回 561×7476 WEBP。插件遵守这条限制。兼容结论针对上述实测版本，其他宿主版本需要对应验证。

dsh-read-image-view README · 首次安装测试浏览器：node node_modules/playwright-core/cli.js install chromium npm run test:browser ``` CI 运行纯逻辑与契约测试、bundle 同步检查和真实 Chromium 回归。`npm run e2e` 另需运行中的 DSH Web 会话。 源码入口：`src/client-src.js`；纯逻辑：`lib/read-image-core.mjs`；提交的发布 bundle：`lib/client.js`。加载、授权、缓存及 URL 生命周期由 DSH 宿主管理；插件不新增文件读取权限或网络端点，TUI 工具数据不受影响。 [20 项参考资料与采用理由](docs/upgrade-references.md) · [变更记录](CHANGELOG.md) · [发布流程](PUBLISH.md) · [MIT 许可](LICENSE) ---

dsh-read-image-view README · English：**Turn DSH `read_image` results into complete inline previews and a zoomable gallery.** View long screenshots, panoramas and transparency in the conversation, including every image in a multi-image result.

Client-only, with zero production dependencies and the host's session-authorized image loader.

dsh-read-image-view README · Install and use：Search for **dsh-read-image-view** in the DSH plugin marketplace, install and restart Harness. For a command-line Web installation:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add npm:dsh-read-image-view@0.4.0
```

Restart `dsh web`, ask the model to read an image, then click its preview.

dsh-read-image-view README · Install and use：**DSH Desktop:** verified in a Windows 11 VM with [DSH Desktop 0.11.1](https://github.com/dataelement/dsh-desktop/releases/tag/v0.11.1), embedding Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**. It uses a **web profile** inside its own data directory. Prefer installing in the desktop app, then **Harness → Restart**. An external CLI's default DSH_HOME may belong to a different installation; set the desktop app's actual DSH_HOME before using CLI commands for it. Desktop also manages independent plugin generations: a CLI install can be overwritten by the previously registered generation on restart. Use the in-app plugin manager for upgrades.
dsh-read-image-view README · Install and use：If the host collapses the completed turn or image-reading tool process, expand that process first. The plugin's image row defaults to expanded.

dsh-read-image-view README · What's new in 0.4.0：| Feature | Interaction |
| --- | --- |
| Complete previews | Tall and wide images fit inside their cards without cropping |
| Multi-image gallery | Group reads within a request; navigate every image in each result |
| Zoom and pan | Wheel, +/−, drag and two-finger pinch; fit or 100% |
| Keyboard | ←/→ navigate, +/− zoom, `0` for 100%, `f` to fit, Esc to close |
| Focus | Tab/Shift+Tab stay inside the gallery; closing restores the opener |
| Deferred loading | Request images near the viewport; retry failures; late results cannot reopen a closed gallery |
| Transparency | Checkerboards in both cards and the gallery |

dsh-read-image-view README · What's new in 0.4.0：**100% means one returned bitmap pixel per CSS pixel.** The host can resize or convert the source first. The caption shows returned dimensions and source dimensions when provided. Zooming beyond 100% interpolates the bitmap; it cannot recover discarded detail. Physical screen pixels also differ from CSS pixels at high DPI.

dsh-read-image-view README · Actual Desktop validation：These screenshots come from the actual DSH Desktop renderer in the VM, using the real host attachment store and persisted session. Tool results were constructed as validation fixtures; no model calls were made.

Windows 11 22621.4112, 150% DPI: three images, an error result, navigation, 100%, focus, Esc and reopening. Separate Chromium regressions cover 12000px images, mobile orientation, real pinch input, close-during-load, retry and deferred loading.

dsh-read-image-view README · Actual Desktop validation：The real host rejected a 12000px source image. Desktop validation used a 600×8000 source, normalized by the host to 561×7476 WEBP. The plugin preserves that boundary. Compatibility is verified for these specific versions; other host versions require their own checks.

dsh-read-image-view README · Development and references：```powershell
npm ci
npm run build
npm run check
npm test

CI runs core/contract tests, bundle synchronization and actual Chromium regressions. `npm run e2e` additionally requires a running DSH Web session.

Source: `src/client-src.js`; pure logic: `lib/read-image-core.mjs`; committed release bundle: `lib/client.js`. DSH owns loading, authorization, caching and URL lifetime. The plugin adds no file permissions or network endpoints and leaves TUI tool data unchanged.
